note: Nothing was downloaded or vendored for this lane. Every texture is generated by bake_storm_pbr.py from one seed.

used.name: physically-based material database (already vendored: assets/looks/physically_based, PIN.json)
used.use: indirect: scripts/aircraft_look.py reads paint IOR and metal F0 from it; this lane changes none of those

used.name: scripts/aircraft_wet_layer.py, scripts/aircraft_look.py, core/scene/beauty_look.py, core/scene/weather_look.py
used.use: the HEAD numbers the lane overrides and the shared storm look numbers, pinned by the test

used.name: Lekner and Dorf, 'Why some things are darker when wet', Applied Optics 27(7), 1988
used.use: porous-surface darkening is the model aircraft_wet.hlsl uses; a clear-coated panel is not porous

used.name: S. Lagarde, 'Water drop 3b - Physically based wet surfaces', 2013
used.use: porosity as the darkening control; non-porous surfaces change gloss, not albedo

used.name: PBR base-colour validation range sRGB 50-243 for non-metals
used.licence: citation only (from memory: Unity / Frostbite validation charts; UNCALIBRATED)
used.use: ALBEDO_SRGB_RANGE; the upper end equals the paint master's existing AlbedoMax 0.9
